articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bittensor (TAO) surges 31.9%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Near Protocol (NEAR), up 22.2% from Friday, was also a top performer.

articles.title: Wall Street and crypto are crashing into each other as tokenized treasury markets hit $14.6 billion
articles.snippet: Not all crypto exchange executives agree, but the data does not lie: centralized exchange trading volumes dropped more than 11% to $4.61 trillion, their lowest since late 2024.

articles.title: Kraken rolls out perpetual futures for US traders through CFTC-regulated venue
articles.snippet: The offering follows Kraken's acquisition of Bitnomial and comes amid a broader push to bring crypto derivatives trading onshore.

articles.title: Bitcoin analysis warns over BTC price rejection as $67K approaches
articles.snippet: Bitcoin snatched upside liquidity as the US trading session began, but traders warned over a failure to preserve BTC price gains.

articles.title: Trump says Iran peace deal to be signed Sunday, contradicting Tehran
articles.snippet: Crypto analyst Michaël van de Poppe said a peace deal, which would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, would likely send liquidity back to risk-on assets such as cryptocurrencies.
